company.name: Geomate Links Consulting Limited
company.mission: To be one of the most admired, profitable and competitive companies, noted for provision of quality services to our esteemed clients.
company.corporateInfo: The strength of Geomate Links Consulting Limited lies in the ability of the company to satisfy the service specifications demanded by her clients. Our services are built on technical knowledge and professional experience. Part of our corporate mission is to influence the practice of surveying and geoinformatics positively — through modern methods of data collection, processing and presentation — and to set enduring principles of quality control and high ethical standards.
company.legalStructure: Geomate Links Consulting Limited is a wholly Nigerian consultancy firm registered in November 2007 with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC), registration number RC746106. The company is directed by a Chairman/Managing Director alongside the board, with a mandate to bring professional surveying services within reach of every Nigerian.
company.humanResources: Geomate Links maintains experienced permanent personnel and draws on resource persons from higher institutions and private organisations. The quality of our staff and associates ensures timely sourcing of every input required for speedy project execution and high-quality output.

address.postal: P. O. Box 30216, Secretariat Post Office, Ibadan

about.label: 01 — About
about.title: A Nigerian practice built on measured evidence
about.body: Geomate Links Consulting Limited has practised surveying, mapping and geoinformatics since November 2007 from its corporate office in Ibadan, Oyo State. Our work spans cadastral and engineering surveys, UAV and satellite mapping, bathymetric investigation of dam reservoirs, digitization of legacy records, and GIS/LIS deployment.
